associations.rationale: This gives every indecomposable a unique index in an opaque `Fin 3` family, but it neither displays that family as the three listed representations nor asserts here that every family member is indecomposable, so it does not alone state the exact three-class claim.
This only constructs a Fin 3-indexed family of representations; its opaque type does not state that these are the three source indecomposables.
This verifies indecomposability of the three constructed representatives, a necessary half of the classification but not completeness or uniqueness.

The dimension-vector alternatives and injectivity condition are a necessary characterization of an indecomposable A2 representation, but they do not themselves assert the three unique isomorphism classes.
